en: Hey, guess what! Takashi is playing a live show!
ja: ねえ聞いてよ！タカシが今度ライブするんだって！
answer: Hey, guess what! Takashi is playing a live show!

ja: え、あんたの推しでしょ？

en: The heavy metal guy, right? That's awesome. Are you going?
ja: あの、ヘビメタの。よかったじゃん。行くの？
answer: The heavy metal guy, right? That's awesome. Are you going?

en: The thing is, it's in Nagoya.
ja: でもさー、名古屋なんだよね。
answer: The thing is, it's in Nagoya.

en: If I go, I have to stay the night, and the bullet train isn't cheap either.
ja: 行くとしたら泊まりだし、新幹線代もかかるし、キツいかも。
answer: If I go, I have to stay the night, and the bullet train isn't cheap either.

en: If only it were in Tokyo or Yokohama.
answer: If only it were in Tokyo or Yokohama.

en: Nagoya, huh. That's rough on your wallet.
ja: 名古屋かー、金銭的にキツいね。
answer: Nagoya, huh. That's rough on your wallet.

en: Maybe I'll skip it this year.
answer: Maybe I'll skip it this year.

en: I'm betting he'll play somewhere closer next year.
ja: 来年、こっちでライブしてくれることに賭ける。
answer: I'm betting he'll play somewhere closer next year.

en: But there's no guarantee he'll do a show next year.
ja: でも、来年ライブやるとは限らないよ。
answer: But there's no guarantee he'll do a show next year.

en: This year could be the last one, or he could go overseas next year.
ja: 今年で終わりかもしれないし、来年は海外行っちゃうかもしれないし。
answer: This year could be the last one, or he could go overseas next year.

en: Okay, I've decided! I'm going! I'll get a part-time job and save up!
ja: よし、決めた！行く！バイトしてお金貯めよ！
answer: Okay, I've decided! I'm going! I'll get a part-time job and save up!

ja: いいじゃーん！行ってきなよ！

en: So, you'll let me copy your homework, right?
ja: だからさ、宿題見せてね！
answer: So, you'll let me copy your homework, right?
